steps.title: The liar’s game
steps.body: Everyone hides their dice under a cup. The goal: guess (or bluff) the total number of dice showing a given value across the whole table.

steps.title: Bid or call it out
steps.body: On your turn, raise the previous bid, or shout LIAR! if you think the last player is bluffing.

steps.title: The 1: a special wildcard
steps.body: The 1 counts as any value in the current bid — it’s the wildcard. But switching your bid to 1s roughly halves the required quantity; switching back from 1s to another value roughly doubles it (+1).

steps.title: Who drinks?
steps.body: The dice get revealed: the loser of the bet drinks based on the gap. Dice are re-rolled and the game goes on.

steps.title: One word, two teams
steps.body: Everyone gets a secret word. Almost everyone shares the same one — one or two players (the impostors) get a different, close word.

steps.title: One clue, never the word
steps.body: Each round, give a clue about your word without ever saying it. Listen to the others to spot who has a different word.

steps.title: Vote and win
steps.body: After the clues, vote to eliminate a suspect. The village wins by unmasking every impostor; the impostors win by surviving until they’re tied with the rest.

steps.title: Guess the real answer
steps.body: All the bluffs and the real answer are shuffled together with no author shown. Vote for the one you think is real — never your own!

steps.title: Double points
steps.body: Find the real answer to score points. And if someone votes for YOUR bluff, you score too — the more people you fool, the more you win!

steps.title: Describe without the taboo words
steps.body: Get your team to guess the word out loud, without ever saying the 4 forbidden words shown below!

steps.title: Your team clicks GOT IT
steps.body: As soon as a teammate guesses the word, they click GOT IT: +1 point and the next word appears instantly. The describer can also PASS a word that's too hard.

steps.title: The other team is listening
steps.body: If the describer says a taboo word, an opponent who hears it clicks TABOO! — the word is skipped, no point for anyone.

steps.title: Pick a word
steps.body: When it's your turn to draw, pick 1 word out of the 3 offered — no one else can see them!

steps.title: Draw, others guess
steps.body: Draw the word on the canvas while everyone else types their guesses. First correct guess scores big, and you score too!

steps.title: Early round end
steps.body: As soon as everyone has guessed, the round ends. Otherwise, time runs out and the word is revealed to everyone.

steps.title: Write a starting sentence
steps.body: Each player starts their own chain with a sentence — it will circulate and transform throughout the game!

steps.title: Draw or guess, alternating
steps.body: Each round, you receive the last link of a chain: a sentence to draw, or a drawing to guess in one sentence. You never see the whole chain!

steps.title: The final laugh
steps.body: Once every round is played, each complete chain is revealed from start to finish — get ready to laugh!

steps.title: The board
steps.body: Move around the 30 tiles in turn order. Each tile has its own twist: a sip, a bonus, a curse, a mini-game…

steps.title: On your turn
steps.body: Roll the dice on your turn, discover your tile’s effect, and sometimes pick a target for an effect that hits another player.

steps.title: About the sips
steps.body: Some tiles make you drink, others spare you — everyone gets their turn, sip after sip, until the game ends.

page.onlineOnly: The quiz is played online: everyone answers secretly on THEIR phone, like a real buzzer!

game.answerPrompt: Answer fast: the quicker you are, the more you score!
game.answerSent: Answer sent — waiting for the others… ⚡

steps.title: The big quiz
steps.body: A multiple-choice question appears for everyone. Your phone becomes a buzzer!

steps.title: Answer fast
steps.body: Pick your answer as fast as you can: the quicker you are, the more points you score. A wrong (or too slow) answer costs sips.

steps.title: The podium
steps.body: After all the questions, the final ranking appears — and whoever’s last finishes their drink.

page.onlineOnly: Werewolf is played online: everyone gets a secret role on THEIR phone. 4 players minimum — or add bots in the lobby!

steps.title: A village full of secrets
steps.body: Everyone gets a secret role: villager, werewolf, or special roles (seer, witch, bodyguard…).

steps.title: Night and day
steps.body: At night, the wolves pick a victim while special roles act in secret. By day, the whole village debates and votes to eliminate a suspect.

steps.title: Who wins?
steps.body: The village wins by eliminating every wolf; the wolves win once they equal (or outnumber) the rest of the village. The dead become ghosts 👻 and watch the rest of the game.
